name: – Michael McNamara – Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the exchange, assistance and training programme for the protection of the euro against counterfeiting for the period 2028-2034 (the 'Pericles V' programme) and repealing Regulation (EU) 2021/840
part_text:
The European Parliament wants to keep funding a programme that helps countries work together to fight fake euro notes and coins. The programme would run from 2028 to 2034 with about 7.8 million euros. Parliament wants it to also cover fake money linked to a future digital euro, threats from artificial intelligence, and counterfeits sold online. It also wants training for authorities in countries outside the euro area where fakes are made.

- The budget rises to 7.8 million euros, and the programme now covers digital euro and artificial intelligence threats.
- It affects national police and anti-fraud authorities, the European Central Bank, Europol and Eurojust.
- Parliament has set its position; talks with EU governments come next before the law can be adopted.
